The '''Flaming Ragerunner''' was an insignia that depicted a seated winged beast viewed from the side.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] was emblazoned with one such insignia.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> It was later used as the logo for [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek Incorporated]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The emblem is visible on [[Luke Skywalker's T-16 skyhopper model|Luke's toy skyhopper]] in {{Film|IV}}, but not on his [[Luke's T-16 skyhopper/Legends|actual skyhopper]] in the background of the same scene. ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' explains this by describing it as an "emblem Luke would like to add," but other sources, such as ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)]]'', show it on the full-sized skyhopper.
